senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to grow, spread,] to improve, grow in value.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 135b:2">B. Bath. 135ᵇ</cite> <he>שֶׁבַח ששָׁבְחוּ וכ׳</he> an improvement which the estate obtained of itself, i.e. a natural increase in value by growth.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 143b:9">Ib. 143ᵇ</cite> <he>שבחו נכסים מחמת נכסים</he> the estate improved through outlays made from the estate; <he>שבחו … מחמת עצמן</he> the estate improved owing to their (the heirs’) own expense of labor or money; a. e.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 14b:13">B. Mets. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>גזל … והִשְׁבִּיחָהּ</he> if one took unlawful possession of a field and sold it to another person who made improvements in it.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 124b:6">B. Bath. 124ᵇ</cite> <he>שבח שהִשְׁבִּיתוּ יורשין וכ׳</he> an improvement which the heirs made after their father’s death.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:3">Ib. IX, 3</cite> <he>השביחו לאמצע</he>, v. <cite ref="A02056"><he>אֶמְצַע</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 9:3">Ib.</cite> <he>הִשְׁבִּיחָה לעצמה</he> the increase of value which she produced goes to her own profit; a. fr.
<cite ref="Mishnah Maaser Sheni 2:1">Maas. Sh. II, 1</cite>; a. e.
<cite ref="Eruvin 19a:3">Erub. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>ולא עוד אלא שמְשַׁבֵּחַ</he> and not only (does he submit to God’s judgment in silence), but he even praises.

Sot. VII, 8 ושִׁבְּחוּהוּ חכמים and the scholars praised him for it. Mekh. Bo, s. 12 הודו ושִׁבְּחוּ וכ׳ they offered thanks and praise that the emeny did not see (their dead) &c. Ib. צריך לשַׁבֵּחַ must offer praise; a. fr.—Part. pass. מְשׁוּבָּח; f. מְשׁוּבַּחת; pl. מְשׁוּבָּחִין; מְשׁוּבָּחוֹת

senses.gloss: praiseworthy. Y. Yoma VI, 43ᶜ top מש׳ בגופו a sacrifice superior as to its body (stouter), מש׳ במראיו better looking.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:11">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>המש׳ שבשירים</he> the most precious of songs.
Num. R. s. 163 (ref. to Num. XIII, 22) שהפסולת שלה משובחת מן המש׳ (not משובח), v. פְּסוֹלֶת; a. fr.— to quiet, tame.—Part. pass. as ab.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 729">Yalk. Num. 729</cite> <he>כחו … ומה מש׳</he> how great is the strength of this lion, and how tame he is!
senses.label: b

units: Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII ואחר כך היא מִשְׁתַּבַּחַת והולכת ed. Bub. (oth. ed. מַשְׁבַּחַת Hif.) and at last it grows bright and brighter; Cant. R. to VI, 10 מרטבת (corr. acc.).

Gen. R. s. 34 כל זמן שהוא כותשה היא משתבחת the more he beats it (the flax), the better it grows; ib. s. 32; ib. s. 55 משת׳ והולכת; Midr. Till. to Ps. XI מַשְׁבַּחַת והולכת (Hif.; ed. Bub. משבח והולך, read: מַשְׁבִּיחַ, or משובח); Yalk. Gen. 95 משובחת; Yalk. Ps. 654 משב׳; a. e.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 45b:7">Bekh. 45ᵇ</cite> <he>הקב״ה מִשְׁתַּבֵּחַ בבעלי קומה</he> the Lord prides himself on conquering men of high stature.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 9">Ex. R. s. 9</cite> <he>אותו רשע משתבח ואומר וכ׳</he> that wicked man (Pharaoh) prides himself and says, that he is a god; a. e.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 41:1">Ex. R. s. 41</cite> <he>הקב״ה יִשְׁתַּבַּח שמו ויתעלה זכרו</he> the Holy One, blessed be he, praised be his name, and exalted his memory; a. fr.
